summary: RelayDesk: ADR, bootstrap, CI, auth, audit, orgs/RBAC, invitations, tickets, assignment, workflow, comments, reporting, hardening, e2e, CD.

tasks.title: ADR: RelayDesk architecture, tenancy and CI/CD
tasks.description: Write ADRs (one file each) covering: modular monolith layout and module boundaries; tenant isolation strategy (request-context org, scoped repositories, optional RLS); token strategy (JWT access + rotating hashed refresh tokens, Argon2); CI/CD and rollback approach.
acceptance_criteria: ADR files contain context, options, decision, consequences
Tenant isolation and token decisions are explicit

tasks.title: Bootstrap FastAPI app, DB, Alembic, Docker
tasks.description: Create app package (main, core: config/database/security/exceptions/logging/dependencies; shared; modules skeleton), pyproject with pinned lock, Alembic setup, SQLAlchemy 2 base with UUID/timestamptz conventions, structured logging, error format, /api/v1/health/live and /ready (checks PostgreSQL), Dockerfile, docker-compose with postgres 16, .env.example, test fixtures with isolated PostgreSQL database. Keep existing app.py tests passing or migrate them.
acceptance_criteria: Alembic upgrade head works on empty DB
Docker image builds; compose starts app+postgres

tasks.title: CI pipeline on pull requests
tasks.description: GitHub Actions workflow: install deps, Ruff lint+format check, MyPy, pytest with Postgres service and coverage, Bandit, pip-audit, Docker build, Alembic migration validation, OpenAPI export validation. Update CODEOWNERS if needed.
acceptance_criteria: Postgres service used for integration tests

tasks.title: Authentication module
tasks.description: Users model/migration, POST /auth/register, /login, /refresh (rotation, reuse detection), /logout (revocation), /password-reset and /confirm, GET /users/me, activate/deactivate. Argon2 hashing, short-lived JWT with strict alg/exp validation, refresh tokens stored hashed.
acceptance_criteria: Valid login returns tokens; invalid credentials return proper error code

tasks.title: Audit logging module
tasks.description: AuditLog model/migration (JSONB metadata, no cascade delete), audit service interface used by other modules, read-only audit listing for authorized roles (no edit/delete APIs), integrate with auth events where applicable.
acceptance_criteria: Audit service records event id, org, actor, action, entity type/id, metadata, timestamp
No API can modify or delete audit events

tasks.title: Organizations, memberships and RBAC
tasks.description: Organization and Membership models, organization registration with initial admin, GET/PATCH /organizations/current, members list/update/delete, tenant request context (active membership check), central permission matrix per spec section 3 with deny by default. Emit audit events.
acceptance_criteria: Unique slug; resources scoped to org
Only admins manage org and members

tasks.title: Invitations
tasks.description: Invitation model, POST/GET /organizations/invitations, POST /invitations/accept, POST /organizations/invitations/{id}/revoke. Secure random token stored only as hash, expiry, single use, role assignment, audit events. Admin and manager can invite.
acceptance_criteria: Expired, revoked or accepted invitations cannot be accepted

tasks.title: Categories and tickets CRUD
tasks.description: Category endpoints (POST, GET, PATCH, DELETE=deactivate) and ticket models, create/get/update/list/archive with filters (status, priority, category, assignee), search, sorting, pagination format per spec, indexes, visibility by role (all/assigned/own). Audit events.
acceptance_criteria: Ticket requires valid category and priority

tasks.title: Ticket assignment
tasks.description: Assignment model with history, POST /tickets/{id}/assign and /unassign, reassign closes previous assignment, assignee must belong to org, GET /tickets/{id}/history includes assignments, audit events.

tasks.title: Workflow state machine
tasks.description: POST /tickets/{id}/transitions enforcing the spec transition table, explicit reopen operation for CLOSED, resolved_at/closed_at, transition records with actor/prev/new, authorization (admin/manager/agent), audit events.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests cover full transition table

tasks.title: Comments and internal notes
tasks.description: Comment model, POST/GET /tickets/{id}/comments chronological, is_internal notes hidden from requesters, no update/delete, audit events.
acceptance_criteria: Internal notes never returned to requesters
Access limited by ticket visibility and org

tasks.title: Reporting
tasks.description: GET /reports/overview, /reports/tickets, /reports/agents: totals, by status/priority/category/agent, resolution statistics; org-scoped; admin/manager only.

tasks.title: Security hardening and security tests
tasks.description: Rate limiting on sensitive endpoints, brute-force login protection, secure CORS, security headers, request size limits, safe error responses, no secrets in logs; security test suite (cross-org IDOR, role enforcement, JWT misuse, mass assignment, token reuse).
acceptance_criteria: Security tests pass for all modules

tasks.title: E2E tests, performance profile, docs
tasks.description: End-to-end test of the full spec flow (register org, login, category, invite, accept, ticket, assign, status, comment, resolve/close, audit, reports), documented load profile with P95 check script, complete OpenAPI descriptions, README, deployment and secret-rotation docs. Verify coverage >=85%.

tasks.title: CD pipeline and production Docker
tasks.description: Deployment workflow after merge: build immutable image tagged with commit SHA, push to registry, run migrations, deploy, readiness and smoke checks, automatic rollback on failure; production Docker config, env separation.
acceptance_criteria: Automatic rollback on failure without reversing destructive migrations
